summary: Shows running the edited exploded module with the wrapper's execute subcommand, which puts debug_dir first on sys.path and uses the args file, so you can iterate before copying fixes back.
questions: How do I rerun a module after editing its exploded code?
How does execute pick up my modified module files?

answer_card.title: Run an exploded module
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell-session
$ python AnsiballZ_ping.py execute
```
`execute` puts `debug_dir` first on `sys.path` and runs with the `args` file. Iterate until you find the problem, then copy changes into your real module and test with `ansible` or `ansible-playbook`.
